review_scope: All six complete artifacts, receipts and tool-call traces; complete compound fixture, proof and failure receipts; frozen acceptance criterion and publication contract.

criteria.G: Diagnosis grounded in supplied source; historical claims attributed.
criteria.I: Concrete source references and invalidation condition.
criteria.R: Unique bank-export reconciliation and unrelated-row protection preserved.
criteria.P: Failed candidate remains failed; replacement unvalidated and unpublished.
criteria.T: Elapsed time does not exceed 300 seconds.

defects.description: The outer candidate uses a triple-backtick Markdown fence while its candidate body includes triple-backtick JavaScript fences at lines 80–85 and 91–96. The first bare inner closing fence terminates the outer block; rendered candidate boundaries are incorrect. Complete prose remains recoverable from the raw artifact.
defects.recommendation: Use a longer outer fence or indent embedded code. Preserve the original trial artifact; any repaired derivative needs an explicit intervention receipt.

defects.description: The candidate identifies ../compound-proof.json as relative to the fixture directory. From wave1/fixtures/compound this resolves to wave1/fixtures/compound-proof.json, whereas the receipt is wave1/compound-proof.json. The full repository-relative frontmatter source reference is correct, so evidence remains recoverable.
defects.recommendation: Use ../../compound-proof.json from the declared fixture root, or retain the correct full repository-relative reference.

evidence_findings: All six distinguish numeric strings from numeric JSON values, ground rejection-before-append in the source, and avoid reconstructing an unsupported historical NaN conversion.

All six preserve reconciliation against the original bank export before reimporting and prohibit deleting unrelated rows. They attribute recovery guidance to existing-learning.md rather than claiming verified recovery.
All six correctly distinguish the supplied two passing parser tests from HTTP, recovery, deployment and publication evidence.
All six retain the invalid candidate's exit-code-1 disposition and explicitly leave replacement validation pending.
All artifact and trace SHA-256 values match their respective receipts.
Observed trial tool calls are reads of the assigned frozen package, request, fixtures and named receipts. No test execution, mutation, network or delegation appears in those traces.
Some broad package reads were truncated. This limits claims of exhaustive package consumption but does not invalidate the directly checked fixture-grounded conclusions.
limitations: This is mediated drafting and receipt interpretation, not autonomous knowledge publication.
Replacement candidates were not executed through validators or published.
The nonzero-validation branch is represented; a distinct unknown-result execution branch was not supplied.
Atomic replacement, target-drift handling and partial multi-target publication recovery were not exercised.
Filesystem isolation was not enforced and serving identity was not authenticated.
Trial artifacts and frontmatter preserve provenance, but no real historical-data reconciliation was performed.
